data.name: Ghuraibah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'gharaba', meaning 'to be far away, to leave, to be afraid'. The name Ghuraibah is a feminine form of Ghurab, which means 'the fearless one, the valiant one'. In the context of Islamic tradition, it represents a woman of strength and courage.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes bravery and resilience in the face of adversity.
data.numerology_meaning: In Islamic numerology, the number 5 signifies change and adaptability. Ghuraibah is a name that encourages the bearer to embrace new experiences and challenges with courage and determination.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ghuraibah highlights the valor and resilience of women in Islamic culture. It personifies the idea of a fearless and strong woman, who is not easily intimidated or overwhelmed. This name would have inspired respect and admiration in communities where it was used.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Ghuraibah signifies the inner strength and courage that a person can possess despite external fears or challenges. It serves as a reminder of Allah's promise of support and guidance, as expressed in the Quran: "And Allah will be the protector of those who have faith: He will extract them from darkness into light. But as for those who disbelieved, their protectors are the tags of Satan. He will extract them from light into darkness. Those are the Companions of the Right Hand [i.e., the blessed]. But those who disbelieved will be the Companions of the Left Hand [i.e., the cursed]" (Quran 2:257). Therefore, Ghuraibah, as a spiritual symbol, represents a woman of faith and inner strength, one who relies on Allah's protection and guidance in times of fear and uncertainty.
